import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path("/Users/tal/dev/melian-worktrees/quiet-run-details")
scratch = root / "tmp/quiet-run-details-fix5"
inventory_path = root / "docs/progress-log/2026-10-27-quiet-run-details-level-outcomes-mutants.json"
inventory = json.loads((scratch / "enumerated.json").read_text())
assert inventory["omitted"] == 0
source_path = root / "packages/pipeline/src/telemetry.ts"
original = source_path.read_text()
command = ["npx", "vitest", "--run", "--maxWorkers=1", "packages/pipeline/test/telemetry.test.ts", "-t", "matches escalated lens outcomes"]
inventory.update({
    "base": "5e1523c8bad4884e79311cb9b2f422db1fb3eac9",
    "enumeratedHead": (scratch / "snapshot").read_text().strip(),
    "sourceSha256": hashlib.sha256(original.encode()).hexdigest(),
    "enumerationCommand": "node scripts/enumerate-mutants.mjs 5e1523c8bad4884e79311cb9b2f422db1fb3eac9...HEAD --json --limit 10000",
    "runnerSource": Path(__file__).read_text(),
})
for mutant in inventory["mutants"]:
    mutant.update({"claim": "new-test", "evidence": "telemetry.test.ts > matches escalated lens outcomes (quick=ended, careful=ran, level=careful); (quick=ran, careful=failed, level=careful); (quick=ran, careful=failed, level=undefined)", "survivorClasses": ["dropped-value"] if mutant["mutatorName"] == "StringLiteral" else ["compound-condition"], "tests": command})
inventory_path.write_text(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2) + "\n")
lines = original.splitlines(keepends=True)
try:
    for index, mutant in enumerate(inventory["mutants"]):
        start = sum(map(len, lines[:mutant["line"] - 1])) + mutant["column"]
        end = sum(map(len, lines[:mutant["endLine"] - 1])) + mutant["endColumn"]
        source_path.write_text(original[:start] + mutant["replacement"] + original[end:])
        log = scratch / f"mutant-{index}.log"
        try:
            with log.open("w") as output:
                result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=120)
        finally:
            source_path.write_text(original)
        failing = [line.strip() for line in log.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip().startswith("FAIL ")]
        killed = result.returncode == 1 and bool(failing) and all("matches escalated lens outcomes" in name for name in failing)
        mutant["result"] = {"exitCode": result.returncode, "killed": killed, "failingTests": failing, "log": str(log.relative_to(root))}
        inventory_path.write_text(json.dumps(inventory, indent=2) + "\n")
        print(index, mutant["mutatorName"], "killed" if killed else "SURVIVED OR INVALID", flush=True)
        if not killed:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Mutant {index} needs investigation")
finally:
    source_path.write_text(original)
